projects.title: SubstiFlow
projects.summary: Replaces spreadsheet-driven substitution chaos with a local desktop workflow: draft timetables, validate room and faculty constraints, resolve leave conflicts in seconds, and export clean daily cover schedules without external cloud dependencies.
projects.problem: Academic department coordinators waste hours every morning manually cross-referencing paper timetables and faculty WhatsApp leaves, creating double-bookings and room assignment clashes.
howItWorks: Constraint engine parses faculty weekly workloads, subject allocations, and room quotas into SQLite tables.
Leave resolver flags absentee professors and sorts eligible substitutes using workload balancing heuristics.
Conflict matrix checks room availability, period adjacency, and subject qualifications deterministically.
One-click export produces print-ready PDF daily substitution rosters and departmental notifications.
highlights: 100% offline-first architecture: Zero external API requirements or data transmission.
Comprehensive constraint validator test matrix verifying 200+ edge-case faculty conflict allocations.
Deterministic substitution ranking algorithm eliminating scheduling double-bookings.
Local SQLite migration suite tested across schema upgrades.

projects.title: Noctra
projects.tagline: PDF & presentation dark-mode conversion and study platform
projects.summary: Browser-first document conversion utility and AI-assisted study workspace that transforms high-contrast white PDF textbooks and slide decks into eye-friendly dark mode themes with intelligent color-inversion and high-fidelity rendering.
projects.problem: Reading white academic PDFs and slides at night causes extreme eye fatigue, but naive browser dark mode extensions invert embedded diagrams and charts into illegible negatives.
howItWorks: PDF.js renders vector document pages onto dedicated HTML5 Canvas elements in high resolution.
Selective luminance inversion preserves original color matrices for embedded diagrams and photographic charts.
Local Web Worker threads execute canvas color manipulation off the main UI thread to prevent stutter.
Interactive study workspace offers synchronized document note-taking and PDF bookmarking.
highlights: High-performance Canvas filter engine processing 100+ page textbooks completely in-browser.
Smart color-preserving inversion: Inverts text and backgrounds while preserving photographic fidelity.
Automated visual regression test suite verifying rendering fidelity across complex academic charts.
Zero cloud upload: Complete local file processing ensuring student privacy.

projects.title: DSCASC AI
projects.tagline: Student guidance and NLP-based assistance for campus services
projects.summary: An academic guidance assistant built around an explainable NLP pipeline: normalizes student queries, builds TF-IDF vector models, ranks with cosine similarity, and falls back gracefully below confidence thresholds.
projects.problem: College students and prospective applicants frequently struggle to locate official guidance on admissions, fees, syllabus, and placement schedules across dispersed circulars and PDF notices.
howItWorks: Text preprocessing pipeline normalizes college jargon, course abbreviations (BCA, MCA, MBA), and common student typos.
Vector engine generates TF-IDF representations from curated institutional knowledge bases.
Cosine similarity rankings identify the closest official responses with inspectable confidence scores.
Queries falling below a 0.45 similarity threshold gracefully trigger structured contact cards rather than guessing answers.
highlights: Deterministic explainability: Vector scores and similarity rankings are fully inspectable, eliminating LLM hallucinations.
Zero recurring inference costs: Runs entirely client/server-side without external paid API keys.
Comprehensive intent-matching test matrix covering 40+ curated academic categories.
Typo resilience test suite verifying query resolution across misspelled student prompts.

projects.title: ExamGuard
projects.tagline: Examination management & identity verification for secure exam entry
projects.summary: Connects student registration, hall tickets, seating plans, invigilation, and browser-based identity checks into a single verifiable examination platform.
projects.problem: College exam halls suffer from impersonation, misplaced hall tickets, chaotic manual seating allocation, and fragmented malpractice reporting.
howItWorks: Admissions pipeline issues tamper-resistant cryptographic hall tickets with QR verification.
Biometric entry gate verifies candidate identities via browser webcam using local face-embedding models.
Automated seating allocator assigns students to exam halls with randomized row spacing to prevent peeking.
Invigilator dashboard provides live attendance tracking, instant incident logging, and digital signatures.
highlights: UniFace & OpenCV biometric comparison pipeline with anti-spoofing liveness checks.
Cryptographically signed hall ticket QR codes preventing digital forgery.
Integration test suite simulating concurrent candidate verification across multiple halls.
Role-based access control protecting student records and disciplinary history.

projects.title: ReleaseLens
projects.tagline: Release engineering and CI quality documentation
projects.summary: A continuous quality engineering platform combining automated functional testing, accessibility checks, performance audits, and release sign-off documentation into a single dashboard.
projects.problem: Engineering teams often ship software without centralized visibility into QA coverage, performance regressions, or compliance with release quality gates.
howItWorks: GitHub Action runner executes Jest unit tests, Playwright end-to-end flows, and Lighthouse audits.
Quality engine aggregates test outputs, code coverage percentages, and bundle-size differentials.
Automated release blocker triggers if accessibility score drops below 95 or any test fails.
Markdown audit reports are automatically generated and attached to release pull requests.
highlights: Centralized release dashboard consolidating unit, integration, and performance metrics.
Strict quality gates with configurable thresholds preventing broken builds from deploying.
Automated pull request reporting with actionable visual regression diffs.
Self-hosted Node.js test harness with complete mock API pipelines.

projects.title: Anomoly Chat
projects.tagline: Accountless peer-to-peer chat & document transfer between browsers
projects.summary: Creates temporary browser-to-browser rooms using WebRTC data channels. Messages and documents stay in memory and are never saved to a database.
projects.problem: Quickly sharing sensitive documents or notes with nearby peers requires signing into third-party messaging apps, exposing phone numbers, and storing unencrypted files on remote servers.
howItWorks: Signaling server pairs two clients using short-lived 6-character room codes without collecting user identities.
WebRTC direct peer-to-peer DataChannel is established between browsers with end-to-end encryption.
Files are chunked into 16KB ArrayBuffers, transferred directly peer-to-peer, and reassembled in memory.
Closing the browser tab completely wipes all message history and transferred files with zero residual footprint.
highlights: Zero server-side persistence: Signaling server relays SDP offers/answers and never touches payload data.
Direct browser-to-browser WebRTC DataChannels for low-latency text and document transfer.
Network partition tolerance with automated reconnection and graceful teardown.
Security audit confirming zero user tracking, cookie storage, or credential storage.

projects.title: What's Not Up
projects.tagline: Local visual privacy controls for WhatsApp Web
projects.summary: A Manifest V3 browser extension that visually obscures sensitive messaging content already rendered on screen. Features layered DOM detection, independent privacy categories, hover reveals, and panic controls without network telemetry.
projects.problem: Using web messaging in public libraries, classrooms, or open-plan offices leaves private messages, sender identities, and media exposed to shoulder surfing.
howItWorks: Dynamic MutationObservers monitor chat containers for incoming messages, infinite scrolls, and tab changes.
Scoped CSS blur filters obfuscate targeted DOM elements according to user privacy preferences.
Hover-intent triggers unblur specific elements cleanly and re-engages blur immediately upon pointer exit.
Global panic-lock shortcut instantly re-engages maximum obfuscation across all active messaging tabs.
highlights: Independent toggle categories for message bodies, contact names, profile pictures, and media previews.
Zero external network telemetry: Manifest V3 declared with minimal permissions and no remote network calls.
DOM mutation stress tests across rapid infinite-scrolling WhatsApp Web conversations.
Permission audit verifying zero access outside supported messaging origins.
